div.div: One protected request from start to finish: the gateway verifies the token, loads the user and roles (cached 15 minutes in Redis), and only then lets Content serve the Series. Content decides visibility itself for owners and private Reels and asks Friend Service only for other viewers.

div.div:
Logical RPC arrows show the caller awaiting a correlated RabbitMQ response; transport envelopes are abstracted.
Content controller attaches JwtAuthGuard, not global RolesGuard (content.controller.ts:68-71). Public/friends/private policy is invoked only for nonowner nonadmin.
Missing metadata exits before friend access or episode listing; ref preserves this subordinate failure.
